Cinco de Mayo Mexican Food Deals: Celebrate with Flavorful Specials and Unbeatable Offers

Cinco de Mayo, a beloved Mexican holiday, brings people together to celebrate Mexican heritage, culture, and, of course, food! If you’re looking to celebrate Cinco de Mayo 2025 with delicious Mexican cuisine, drink specials, and incredible deals, you’re in the right place. From tacos and margaritas to burritos and salsa, Cinco de Mayo offers the perfect opportunity to indulge in the best authentic Mexican food while enjoying fantastic discounts at your favorite Mexican restaurants.

In this comprehensive guide, we’ll dive deep into the top Cinco de Mayo specials, unique food and drink offers, and how you can make the most of this festive occasion at both fast-food chains and sit-down Mexican restaurants.

Cinco de Mayo: A Day to Celebrate Mexican Cuisine

Cinco de Mayo, meaning “Fifth of May” in Spanish, is widely recognized as a celebration of Mexican culture, particularly the historic Battle of Puebla, where the Mexican army triumphed over the French forces in 1862. In modern times, Cinco de Mayo has become a global celebration of Mexican food, music, and drinks. It’s a time for friends, families, and communities to come together to enjoy flavorful meals and vibrant festivities.

Whether you’re planning a big fiesta or a casual gathering, Cinco de Mayo is an event that calls for mouthwatering Mexican food and refreshing drinks. To help you celebrate in style, we’ve gathered the best Cinco de Mayo deals, food specials, and drink offers from Mexican restaurants and fast-food joints across the country.

Cinco de Mayo 2025 Specials: What to Expect

As Cinco de Mayo 2025 approaches, Mexican restaurants and fast-food chains alike are gearing up for one of the busiest and most exciting days of the year. From taco deals to margarita specials, here’s what you can expect:

Taco Deals on Cinco de Mayo

No Cinco de Mayo celebration is complete without tacos. Many Mexican restaurants and fast-food chains offer unbeatable deals on tacos for this special day. Whether you love classic beef, juicy chicken, or spicy fish tacos, Cinco de Mayo is the perfect occasion to enjoy tacos for a discounted price. Here are some of the best taco deals to look out for:

  • Two Chicken Tacos for Free: Several Mexican restaurants are offering free tacos as part of their Cinco de Mayo specials, with some locations providing two chicken tacos for free when you order certain entrees.

  • Taco Bar: Set up your own taco bar at home and create the perfect taco combination with a variety of fillings, salsas, and toppings. Some restaurants also offer taco bars with unlimited refills on Cinco de Mayo, making it easy to serve a crowd.

  • Deals on Tacos: From “Tacos for $1” to “Buy One, Get One Free” offers, you can expect to find incredible taco deals at popular Mexican eateries such as Moe’s Southwest Grill, Bubbakoo’s Burritos, and El Pollo Loco.

Margarita Specials

When it comes to celebrating Cinco de Mayo, margaritas are a must. Many restaurants offer margarita specials, making it easy to enjoy your favorite tequila-based cocktail without breaking the bank. Look out for these popular drink deals:

  • 5 House Margaritas for a Discounted Price: Some restaurants offer discounts when you purchase a set of house margaritas, making it the perfect option for sharing with friends.

  • Free Chips and Queso with a Margarita Purchase: Enjoy free chips and queso when you order margaritas at participating locations. Pairing margaritas with these appetizers is a must for the ultimate Cinco de Mayo experience.

  • Margarita & Tequila Shots: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo with a variety of margaritas and tequila shots. Mexican restaurants often offer drink specials that include a discounted margarita with every tequila shot purchase.

Drink Specials for Cinco de Mayo

In addition to margaritas, there are plenty of drink specials to enjoy on Cinco de Mayo. From refreshing Mexican beers like Corona and Modelo to unique Mexican candy shots, there’s a drink for everyone.

  • Drink Deals All Day: Many Mexican restaurants feature Cinco de Mayo specials that include drink deals available throughout the day. Enjoy discounted margaritas, tequila shots, and Mexican beers with your meal.

  • Mexican Candy Shots: For a fun twist on traditional cocktails, some locations offer special Mexican candy shots that are perfect for Cinco de Mayo. These vibrant, colorful shots are a fun way to toast the occasion.

  • Cinco de Mayo Drink Specials: Look out for discounted drink specials on Cinco de Mayo, such as “Buy One, Get One Free” margaritas or discounted prices on Mexican beers and cocktails.

Best Authentic Mexican Food Deals

Cinco de Mayo is a great time to savor the best authentic Mexican food. Whether you’re craving enchiladas, quesadillas, burritos, or taquitos, Mexican restaurants offer special pricing on many of their signature dishes. Here’s a look at some of the best authentic Mexican food deals:

  • Burrito Deals: Many restaurants offer discounted burritos or burrito combos for Cinco de Mayo, including popular chains like Moe’s Southwest Grill and El Pollo Loco.

  • Free Chips and Salsa: Enjoy a complimentary side of chips and salsa with your order at select Mexican restaurants. Some places even offer a free side of queso with your burrito or taco order.

  • Appetizer Specials: Start your Cinco de Mayo celebration with appetizers like guacamole, chips and salsa, taquitos, or queso dip, many of which are offered at discounted prices or as part of Cinco de Mayo meal combos.

  • Fast-Food Mexican Deals: Fast-food chains also get in on the Cinco de Mayo fun by offering tasty combos and deals, such as free chips and queso or special pricing on entrée items like tacos and burritos.

Celebrate Mexican Cuisine with a Fiesta

Cinco de Mayo is the perfect time to host a Mexican fiesta with friends and family. Whether you’re ordering takeout from your favorite Mexican restaurant or preparing a feast at home, here are some ways to celebrate Mexican cuisine:

  • Cinco de Mayo Taco Party: Set up a taco bar at home with all your favorite fillings, tortillas, and toppings. Guests can create their own tacos and enjoy a variety of salsas and sides like guacamole, chips, and queso.

  • Mexican Food & Drink Pairing: Pair your tacos, burritos, and enchiladas with the perfect drinks. From house margaritas and Mexican beers to non-alcoholic options like agua fresca, there’s a drink for every palate.

  • Cinco de Mayo Entrees: For a more substantial meal, opt for Mexican entrées like burritos, enchiladas, fajitas, and tamales. Many restaurants offer specials on these hearty dishes to help you celebrate in style.

Cinco de Mayo Deals You Don’t Want to Miss

Whether you’re celebrating Cinco de Mayo 2025 with a small gathering or a large fiesta, here are the top Cinco de Mayo deals that are sure to make your celebration extra special:

  • Free Delivery: Some Mexican restaurants are offering free delivery for Cinco de Mayo orders, making it easy to enjoy your favorite food from the comfort of your home.

  • Specials All Day: Many restaurants offer Cinco de Mayo specials that last all day long, so you can enjoy delicious Mexican food and drinks throughout the celebration.

  • Cinco de Mayo Menu: Check out the special Cinco de Mayo menu at your favorite Mexican restaurant, where you can find limited-time deals and discounts on food and drinks.

The Best Mexican Restaurants for Cinco de Mayo Specials

When looking for the best Cinco de Mayo deals, it’s important to choose a Mexican restaurant that offers authentic cuisine and fantastic specials. Here are some of the top Mexican restaurants where you can enjoy Cinco de Mayo specials:

  • El Pollo Loco: Known for its delicious Mexican food and fast service, El Pollo Loco offers great Cinco de Mayo specials, including deals on tacos, burritos, and margaritas.

  • Moe’s Southwest Grill: Moe’s is a popular choice for Cinco de Mayo celebrations, offering amazing taco deals, burritos, and margarita specials.

  • Bubbakoo’s Burritos: This fast-casual chain serves up delicious Mexican food with plenty of Cinco de Mayo specials, including discounted burritos and drink deals.

Conclusion

Cinco de Mayo 2025 is shaping up to be a celebration full of delicious food, drink specials, and unforgettable deals. Whether you’re craving tacos, margaritas, or the best authentic Mexican dishes, there are plenty of Cinco de Mayo specials to enjoy. From fast-food chains to sit-down restaurants, take advantage of these incredible deals and celebrate Mexican culture in the most flavorful way possible. Enjoy the fiesta with great food, drinks, and unbeatable Cinco de Mayo food and drink specials!
